Accessing directly

 
vlc https://ps1.fpgas.online/live/pi3.m3u8
 Use your own ssh client. user: pi, host: ps1.fpgas.online, port 10322, (password is in login banner)
click to copy: 
ssh -p 10322 pi@ps1.fpgas.online
scp -P 10322 * pi@ps1.fpgas.online:Uploads
